extras.limits_verbatim: 20,000 MB (20 GB) per file per the official plan table; video-only (HLS transcode); 60-day deletion when unviewed for free tier
extras.egress_verbatim: free, explicitly unmetered — 'Unlimited Bandwidth / Never worry about traffic spikes or overage fees'; HLS delivery from their CDN
extras.chaining_verbatim: the quota scales with views rather than accounts, i.e. 250 GB + 250 GB per 1.5k monthly views — a view-inflation loop (or simply many free accounts) turns this into an unbounded pool; each account independently starts at 250 GB
